description: Statements (pq-zether.md 7.2, 7.7, 7.9; serialization v1, P6e plan D15 / R6) built from keygen seeds and Enc parameters: header / words (ints, or hex bytes left-padded to a 32-byte word: addresses 20 B, salt 16 B; opTag, proofSystemId and auditorOn follow from the form and id), objects (keys by KeyGen seed; T = Enc + Trivial(plus_trivial); out = u || v_j; a disclosure's u, v = leg of an Enc), stmt = the bytes under the PQZL id (the PQZH statement differs only in bytes 32..63), keccak256 and authDigest = keccak256(SCAAS-PQZ-AUTH-V1 || keccak256(stmt)) per id; transfers: entryRef, the disclosure bundle R = salt || u || v_t || [v_a] || toUA.
